name: Deep time
description: Ratios from the history of everything, for when someone says something is old.

facts.statement: The universe is about 3 times older than the Earth
The Earth is roughly 15,000 times older than our species
facts.short: the Earth's age in human species lifetimes
facts.source: US Geological Survey and the Smithsonian

facts.statement: Sharks are about 1.3 times older than trees, having appeared roughly 100 million years earlier
facts.short: how much older sharks are than trees
facts.source: Smithsonian National Museum of Natural History

facts.statement: Tyrannosaurus lived closer in time to us than to Stegosaurus, by a factor of about 1.4
facts.short: how much closer T. rex is to you than to Stegosaurus
facts.source: Smithsonian National Museum of Natural History

facts.statement: Cleopatra lived closer to the Moon landing than to the building of the Great Pyramid, by roughly 1.4 times
facts.short: how much closer Cleopatra is to the Moon landing

facts.statement: Written history covers about 5,000 of the roughly 300,000 years our species has existed
facts.short: the share of human existence that was written down

facts.statement: Farming covers only about 4% of the time our species has been around
facts.short: the share of human existence that had agriculture

facts.statement: Oxford University had been teaching for roughly twice as long as the Aztec Empire would last before that empire was founded
facts.short: how much older Oxford is than the Aztec Empire
facts.source: University of Oxford and standard Mesoamerican chronologies

facts.statement: The fax machine was patented in 1843, about thirty years before the telephone
facts.short: how much older the fax machine is than the telephone

facts.statement: Dinosaurs ruled for roughly 700 times longer than modern humans have existed
facts.short: the dinosaurs' reign in human species lifetimes
facts.source: Smithsonian National Museum of Natural History

facts.statement: Global life expectancy has roughly doubled since 1900
facts.short: how much longer people live than a century ago
facts.source: World Health Organization and UN population data

facts.statement: The internet has existed for about 0.01% of the time our species has
facts.short: the share of human existence that had the internet
facts.source: Smithsonian Human Origins Program and internet history
